name: Makoto Daito
about: Born in America to an American father and a Japanese mother. Orphaned and treated as an outsider, he leaves for Japan in 1915. The game follows him for fifty years.

name: Yu Shinjo
about: Half-Japanese and half-British, and a little older than Makoto. The two meet on the ship to Japan and stay tied to each other for life.

name: Orpheus
about: A globe-trotting merchant and smuggler who catches Makoto stowed away on his ship, takes him on, and is the first to notice his ear for music.

name: Heigo Yashima
about: A merchant and boss in Kokura who becomes Makoto's mentor.

name: Tae Matsumoto
about: Works at a cafe in Kokura and is the mistress of a yakuza member.

name: Tadashi Hataoka
about: A swaggering, violent yakuza from Kokura.

name: Genzo Iwaki
performer: Bunta Sugawara (likeness), voiced by Takashi Ukaji
about: The most powerful figure in Kure. The character is built in CG from Toei archive footage of the late Bunta Sugawara, with his family's consent.

name: Tetsuya Hama
about: A young yakuza from Kure and Genzo Iwaki's right-hand man.

name: Suzy Day
about: A gifted singer whose rise in show business starts when she meets Makoto. She is introduced in the Atami part of the story.

name: Kimura
about: An easygoing nightclub worker in Kamurocho.

name: Takashi
about: Makoto's sworn brother and a gifted pianist who brings him back to music. He works alongside Makoto on the show business side.

name: Suekichi
about: Another of Makoto's sworn brothers: carefree, but someone to rely on.

name: Kiyoshi Otsuru
about: A stylish older man who carries himself with authority. His part in the story has not been explained.

name: Takeo Godai
about: A skilled craftsman of few words.

name: The Veiled Stranger
about: Stationed in postwar Japan. Little else has been said.

name: Amaru
about: A man lying low in Japan. The character is built in CG from archive footage and photographs, in collaboration with Amaru Entertainment, and SEGA says no AI is used.
